verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile documents its own ability to start Copilot cloud agent tasks, assign issues to Copilot, and track their progress. These tasks run autonomously in the background and return a ready-to-review pull request, which covers on-demand background agent work. Scheduled or event-triggered automations (docs-24) and GitHub Actions are documented only for the broader GitHub platform, so they earn no credit for the mobile app. Missing for 10: setting up recurring or event-triggered automations from within the mobile app, configuration depth for background runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent tasks on mobile.
